Context: 6. Benefit of Two HRAs

- (ii) In case of civilian employees of Central Government transferred to and posted from a date on or after 1-7-2017 who leave their families behind at the old duty station, the HRA of the old duty station will be calculated on the revised pay drawn on the date of transfer with the percentage rates of HRA effective on the date of transfer. -Para. (vii-a), Part-Ill, Appendix 9.  
Those employees who have not been posted to the N-E. Region outside the N-E. Region are not entitled to this benefit.
